description: This file is a shell script that contains a test suite for verifying the behavior of 'git rev-list' when handling unexpected object types, such as non-blob entries in trees and non-commit parents. It sets up various repository objects, manipulates them into inconsistent states, and checks that 'git rev-list' either processes them correctly or fails as expected.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing the provided shell commands and verifying they succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes commands that are expected to fail, verifying they do indeed fail.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in the command output, verifying its presence.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output files to expected files to verify correctness.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets commands to run after tests complete, such as cleanup actions.
